{{Quote|Waxer. Boil. Am I glad to see you. Trapper and I are the only ones still alive.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=AmIGladToSeeYou-LaPR.flac|<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
'''Trapper''' was an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]] who was then assigned to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to find survivors in the [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] made by a bomb. He later served under [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].

==Biography==
===Battle of Malastare===
Trapper was sent to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to aid General Windu and the Dugs. When the Republic's new bomb, the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|Electro-proton bomb]] came down, it destroyed all of the droid forces but made a large sinkhole. There, he was dispatched on a gunship with Mace Windu to investigate the sinkhole because it sucked up many of their troops. Soon Trapper found survivors with other troopers who took care of the troopers. Then Windu took Trapper, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], and fellow trooper [[Hawkeye/Legends|Hawkeye]] to search for the cause of the sinkhole. Mace and the troopers unknowingly walked onto [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] and disturbed it. It woke up and crushed Hawkeye, but Windu, Ponds, and Trapper escaped.<ref name="The Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>
[[File:Hello_beastie.jpg|thumb|left|250ps|Trapper, Hawkeye, Ponds, and Mace Windu firing at the Zillo Beast]]

===Second Battle of Geonosis===
When the Jedi found out that there was a [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|factory]] on Geonosis making an [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the Jedi took an invasion force to attack the planet and destroy the factory. Trapper was ferried to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] alongside Kenobi in the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] [[Bad Kitty/Legends|''Bad Kitty'']], but they were shot down and crashed in the midst of battle. Kenobi and Trapper were the only survivors. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] found Kenobi's gunship and sent [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] to aid them. Waxer and Boil carried Kenobi and Trapper to the safety of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] where Trapper required medical attention. Soon after the invasion force destroyed the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] and Trapper was taken back to a republic cruiser in a gunship.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />

[[File:Obi_Trapper.png|thumb|right|200ps|Obi-Wan and Trapper among the dead troopers in the fallen gunship]]

==Behind the scenes==
[[Dee Bradley Baker]] voiced Trapper, like every [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />

Trapper's name is a nod to the well-known character, [[Wikipedia:Trapper John McIntyre|"Trapper" John McIntyre]], from the television sitcom [[Wikipedia:M*A*S*H|M*A*S*H]] which aired in the 1970s through early 80s.<ref name="MASH">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-answers-mash-troopers|text=The Clone Wars Answers: MASH Troopers?}}</ref>
